name: JPYSC
oneLiner: JPYSC is Shinsei Trust & Banking's Ethereum-issued, closed-loop yen stablecoin for verified SBI VC Trade users; external-wallet withdrawals remain disabled.
collateral: Segregated Shinsei Trust & Banking trust accounts holding yen cash and Japanese government bonds, with JGBs capped at 50% of reserves under Japan's Type III Electronic Payment Instrument framework
pegMechanism: Trust-bank-backed JPY stablecoin issued by Shinsei Trust & Banking and distributed by SBI VC Trade. The June 24, 2026 launch is closed-loop for verified SBI VC Trade users; the Ethereum token is deployed, but external-wallet withdrawals and open public-chain circulation remain disabled pending legal and tax policy.

notices.title: Walled-garden circulation; peg-derived price
notices.message: JPYSC circulates only inside verified SBI VC Trade accounts — no external-wallet withdrawals and no public-chain secondary market yet. There are zero trading venues, so the tracked price is peg-derived (¥1.00) rather than market-discovered and cannot reflect market stress; supply and market cap come from the DefiLlama path, as CoinGecko's circulating-supply field is inconsistent with its own market cap. Startale says public-chain circulation is technically ready but awaiting legal and tax clarity.

featuredContent.title: Startale Group and SBI Holdings Introduce JPYSC, the First Trust Bank-Backed JPY Stablecoin
featuredContent.description: JPYSC is a Type III electronic payment instrument issued by Shinsei Trust & Banking, jointly developed with SBI Holdings, distributed via SBI VC Trade, and built for institutional cross-border and treasury payments.

featuredContent.title: SBI Holdings unveils trust bank-backed JPY stablecoin with Q2 launch target
featuredContent.description: JPYSC will be Japan's first trust bank-issued yen stablecoin, distinguishing it from JPYC's prepaid payment instrument classification. Trust-based issuers may allocate up to 50% of reserves to government bonds.

featuredContent.title: SBI and Startale Launch JPYSC, Japan's First Trust-Backed Yen Stablecoin
featuredContent.description: JPYSC goes live June 24 2026 in a closed-loop phase for SBI VC Trade users; the trust-beneficiary structure exempts it from the ¥1M transfer cap and allows up to 50% JGB reserves.

milestones.title: Startale and SBI unveil Strium L1 for tokenized securities and RWA trading
milestones.description: Strium described as destination for a 'complementary currency stack' of JPYSC and USDSC; likely deployment target for JPYSC.

milestones.title: Startale Group and SBI Holdings unveil JPYSC, first trust bank-backed JPY stablecoin
milestones.description: Brand and logo announced; issuer Shinsei Trust & Banking, distributor SBI VC Trade, technical lead Startale Group; Q2 2026 launch target under Japan's Type III electronic payment instrument framework.

milestones.title: Startale closes $63M Series A (SBI $50M + Sony $13M) earmarked for JPYSC expansion
milestones.description: Funds target Strium scaling, stablecoin expansion (JPYSC + USDSC), and Startale App enhancement; confirms JPYSC remains a 2026 priority.

milestones.title: SBI VC Trade begins RLUSD distribution in Japan — JPYSC distributor infrastructure now live
milestones.description: SBI VC Trade, JPYSC's designated distributor, operationally distributing Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, de-risking the JPYSC distribution pathway.

milestones.title: Japan FSA activates rules for foreign stablecoins as electronic payment instruments
milestones.description: Japan's regulated framework for qualified foreign stablecoins took effect, advancing the regime JPYSC will launch under.

milestones.title: JPYSC goes live (closed-loop) — issued by Shinsei Trust & Banking, distributed via SBI VC Trade
milestones.description: Japan's first trust-bank-backed yen stablecoin launches with first issuance the same day; ~$63M of cash plus up to 50% JGB reserves held in segregated trust accounts under the Type III electronic payment instrument framework. Initial phase is closed-loop — SBI VC Trade account holders only, with no external-wallet withdrawals or public-chain circulation yet.

milestones.title: SBI, DigiFT, and Startale partner on JPYSC-powered settlement for tokenized capital markets
milestones.description: Partnership covers JPYSC-powered settlement and on-chain dividend distribution for tokenized capital-markets products.

milestones.title: SBI VC Trade opens applications for JPYSC Lending, Japan's first trust-based yen stablecoin lending service
milestones.description: Applications opened July 16 2026 with the lending period starting July 23; a promotional 3% annualized yield applies over a 12-week term, with standard yields projected at 1-3% thereafter. The service runs inside the SBI VC Trade account environment and does not change JPYSC's closed-loop status.
